title: RECOMMEND APPROVAL OF THE APPLICATION OF WECARE MEDICAL
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS]
RECOMMEND APPROVAL OF THE APPLICATION OF WECARE MEDICAL
  TRANSPORT LLC FOR ONE UNRESTRICTED NON-AMBULATORY
  PASSENGER VEHICLE PERMIT AND ONE UNRESTRICTED PUBLIC
  TRANSPORTATION VEHICLE PERMIT
summary: Approval of Wecare Medical Transport LLC application for one unrestricted non-ambulatory passenger vehicle permit and one unrestricted public transportation vehicle permit.
